symptom: `mxcli verify --apply` that passed check and exec and then failed mxcheck printed `Result: FAILED (exit 20)` exactly like a gate that wrote nothing, although exec had already written the project; the broken change stayed in the project until someone noticed.
file: cmd/mxcli/verify/render.go WriteText; test render_test.go TestWriteTextSaysTheScriptsWereAppliedWhenALaterStageFails; help text in cmd/mxcli/cmd_verify.go
cause: The text renderer printed the same Result line for every non-zero exit; Result.Applied (exec ran and wrote) was in the JSON but never read by the text output.
insight: **The signal already existed; the renderer ignored it.** Result.Applied was set when exec applied the scripts, so the fix reads it rather than adding state. The test needs three controls — a passing run, a run that never applied, and a check that failed before exec — because the sentence is only true when exec wrote AND something later failed; a stub of the condition fails exactly one test, the positive one.
